messages:
Emilia (CEO): Thanks for a solid all-hands today. A few folks asked for a single place to follow the reliability items + RCA links so posting here. RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. Recording: https://zoom.redwood/rec/xyz. Please use this thread for follow-ups.

Sam (VP Eng): Quick summary: outage ~35m due to autoscaler misconfig + cache TTL regression after weekend deploy. Mitigation was manual scale + rollback of quantized config. See action items below.

Rohit (SRE Lead): Action items I own: 1) complete RCA timeline and attach missing cache logs by 2026-03-27 2) add alert for cache-TTL drift (rule infra:cache-ttl-drift) 3) run targeted postmortem blameless review doc by next Wed.

Priya (Runtime eng): Rolling back model config now (flag in /etc/redwood/models/flags.yml). Will push change in the 02:00 UTC window and confirm across eu/us/apac. ETA 2026-03-25 03:15 UTC.

Jess (Customer Ops): I'll prepare a customer note (short + plain language) and a list of impacted customers. Draft ETA EOD tomorrow: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-comm-draft. Who signs off? Legal? Ops?

Mark (Support): I'll surface the list to priority accounts and flag any requests for SLA review.

Tara (Product): Product will own the severity bucket mapping and add a line item to the roadmap for "deploy safety checklist" improvements.

Diego (Oncall): Oncall will run a 48h canary with extra tail-latency tracing. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary. I'll post updates after the first 6h.

eng-bot (incidents): Incident note created: INC-2026-248, linked to RCA.

Rohit (SRE Lead): small technical note: the cache TTL regression appears in logs as "ttl_override=true"; grep snippet to extract the traces: kubectl logs -l app=ingress-cache -n prod | grep 'ttl_override' -n -C2

Lina (Docs): I'll fold the "what happened" + "how to avoid" section into onboarding docs and write a one-page postmortem summary for new hires. ETA 2026-03-30.

Sam (VP Eng): Also: no direct pushes to dedicated pools without a change-review. We'll add a gating checklist to the deploy bot.

Jess (Customer Ops): Posted draft here for review: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/ingress-comm-draft (comments open).

Priya (Runtime eng): Confirmed rollback merged: rollback-config-pr-489 at 2026-03-25T02:12Z

Diego (Oncall): Canary live. First 2h metrics look stable; will keep monitoring.

Emilia (CEO): Appreciate the quick coordination. Please react in-thread when you finish your action items so we can close them out.

Sam (VP Eng): I'll ping owners in 48h for brief status notes. If anyone has questions on the RCA please ask here rather than in DMs so all context stays in one place.

Mark (Support): acked.

Rohit (SRE Lead): will post updated RCA link once logs attached.

Jess (Customer Ops): ack :+1: 

Lina (Docs): ack :memo: 

Priya (Runtime eng): updating deployment notes now.

Emilia (CEO): ok closing the loop for now. Thanks everyone!
